title: tc-line-chart
description:
Values over time or along x as lines – one emphasised or each in its own ink – with names at their ends, reference
lines, the nearest point read across series, and a table view.

dots.description: Marks the points: always, never, or "auto" – when there are 16 or fewer

area.description: A soft fill under the emphasised line

x.description: The x field – dates ("2026-03"), numbers or categories; by default "x"

y.description: The y field; a list of fields draws each as a series (a wide table); by default "y"

series.description: The series field, for a long table with one row per x and series

curve.description: How lines bend between points: "smooth", "linear", "step" or "monotone"

xType.description: What x is, when guessing from the values isn't right: "date", "number" or "band"

zero.description: Starts the y axis at zero; by default only for areas

colorMode.description: "highlight" paints the emphasised series and leaves the rest quiet; "categorical" gives each its own ink

endLabels.description: Names the series at their lines' ends; by default when there are several

maxPoints.description: Above this many points a series is thinned (LTTB); by default about two per pixel

referenceLines.description: Dashed horizontal lines, with an optional label: a target, a limit

yLabel.description: The y axis' title, above it: a unit, "Requests / min"

brush.description: Dragging across the plot (or Shift+arrows, then Enter) picks a range of x: "select" shows its change, high and low; "zoom" narrows the chart to it

heading.description: The heading, and the chart's name

highlight.description: What to emphasise: an index, a label, a list of them, "max", "min", "first", "last", "none", or a test

format.description: How values are written: "number", "integer", "percent", "compact", "currency", Intl options, or a function

unit.description: The unit after each value: "%", "ms", " runs"

locale.description: The language for numbers and dates, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's

height.description: The plot's height in px; by default the chart's own for its width

still.description: Draws everything at once: no entrance and no transitions

duration.description: How long a move takes, in ms; by default the chart's own

hideLabels.description: Leaves the values off the marks

hideTooltip.description: No tooltip on hover or focus

bare.description: No card: just the plot, for a chart inside another component

view.description: The chart or the same numbers as a table. Changed by the Table button unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

labels.description: The words it shows and says, merged over defaultChartLabels

Accessor<Row,number>.description: A field name (dot paths allowed) or a function

FormatName.description: Number and date formats, through Intl; the default locale is en-US
